entries.title: A note you closed stays closed
entries.body: A note you closed no longer comes back when its task is dropped later, or when a crewmate picks its work up again after an update. Reading the note of a crewmate that has already finished no longer starts it again: your first mate closes its task instead.
entries.noPicture: The change is that a closed note no longer reappears, which leaves nothing new on screen to show.
